questions.q: Which three kinds of Data 360 objects can Tableau Next use, according to this lesson?
options: Data model objects, data lake objects, and calculated insight objects
questions.explain: Tableau Next connects to DMOs, DLOs, and CIOs from Data 360.

questions.q: Where are CSV files stored after you upload them for use in Tableau Next?
options: In Data 360, as data lake objects
They are discarded after the chart is built
questions.explain: Uploaded CSV files are stored in Data 360 as data lake objects, so they can be used in a semantic model.

questions.q: What is the purpose of the Existing Asset option in the Add menu?
options: Adding a reference to something that already exists, such as a colleague's semantic model, instead of building a copy
questions.explain: Existing Asset opens a dialog for selecting dashboards, visualizations, semantic models, and Data 360 objects to reference.

questions.q: In the semantic model builder canvas, what do the lines between object nodes represent?
options: Relationships between objects, which behave like joins
questions.explain: Relationships link objects, much like joins. A wrong relationship can silently change your totals.

questions.q: What should you do before people build charts on a new semantic model?
options: Publish it to every user immediately
Test the model against real rows and check that the relationships behave as expected
Rename every field to a single letter
questions.explain: Testing with real rows catches wrong relationships and missing fields before they spread into dashboards.
